126    /**
127     * Encode an object into JSON text and write it to out.
128     * <p>
129     * If this object is a {@code Map} or a {@code List}, and it's 
130     * also a {@link JSONStreamAware} or a  {@link JSONAware}, 
131     * {@code JSONStreamAware} or {@code JSONAware} will be 
132     * considered firstly.
133     * <p>
134     * DO NOT call this method from writeJSONString(Writer) of a class that 
135     * implements both JSONStreamAware and (Map or List) with 
136     * "this" as the first parameter, use JSONObject.writeJSONString(Map, 
137     * Writer) or JSONArray.writeJSONString(List, Writer) instead. 
138     * 
139     * @see org.jfree.data.json.impl.JSONObject#writeJSONString(Map, Writer)
140     * @see org.jfree.data.json.impl.JSONArray#writeJSONString(List, Writer)
141     * 
142     * @param value  the value.
143     * @param out  the output writer.
144     * @throws IOException if there is an I/O problem.  
145     */
146    public static void writeJSONString(Object value, Writer out) 
147            throws IOException {
148        if (value == null) {
149            out.write("null");
150            return;
151        }
152        
153        if (value instanceof String) {        
154            out.write('\"');
155            out.write(escape((String) value));
156            out.write('\"');
157            return;
158        }
159        
160        if (value instanceof Double) {
161            if(((Double) value).isInfinite() || ((Double) value).isNaN()) {
162                out.write("null");
163            }
164            else {
165                out.write(value.toString());
166            }
167            return;
168        }
169        
170        if (value instanceof Float) {
171            if (((Float) value).isInfinite() || ((Float) value).isNaN()) {
172                out.write("null");
173            }
174            else {
175                out.write(value.toString());
176            }
177            return;
178        }        
179        
180        if (value instanceof Number) {
181            out.write(value.toString());
182            return;
183        }
184        
185        if (value instanceof Boolean) {
186            out.write(value.toString());
187            return;
188        }
189        
190        if ((value instanceof JSONStreamAware)) {
191            ((JSONStreamAware) value).writeJSONString(out);
192            return;
193        }
194        
195        if ((value instanceof JSONAware)) {
196            out.write(((JSONAware) value).toJSONString());
197            return;
198        }
199        
200        if (value instanceof Map) {
201            JSONObject.writeJSONString((Map) value, out);
202            return;
203        }
204        
205        if (value instanceof List) {
206            JSONArray.writeJSONString((List) value, out);
207            return;
208        }
209        
210        out.write(value.toString());
211    }
212
213    /**
214     * Convert an object to JSON text.
215     * <p>
216     * If this object is a Map or a List, and it's also a JSONAware, JSONAware 
217     * will be considered firstly.
218     * <p>
219     * DO NOT call this method from toJSONString() of a class that implements 
220     * both JSONAware and Map or List with 
221     * "this" as the parameter, use JSONObject.toJSONString(Map) or 
222     * JSONArray.toJSONString(List) instead. 
223     * 
224     * @see org.jfree.data.json.impl.JSONObject#toJSONString(Map)
225     * @see org.jfree.data.json.impl.JSONArray#toJSONString(List)
226     * 
227     * @param value the value.
228     * @return JSON text, or "null" if value is null or it's an NaN or an INF 
229     * number.
230     */
231    public static String toJSONString(Object value){
232        if (value == null) {
233            return "null";
234        }
235        
236        if (value instanceof String) {
237            return "\"" + escape((String) value) + "\"";
238        }
239        
240        if (value instanceof Double){
241            if(((Double) value).isInfinite() || ((Double) value).isNaN()) {
242                return "null";
243            }
244            else {
245                return value.toString();
246            }
247        }
248        
249        if (value instanceof Float) {
250            if (((Float) value).isInfinite() || ((Float) value).isNaN()) {
251                return "null";
252            }
253            else {
254                return value.toString();
255            }
256        }        
257        
258        if (value instanceof Number) {
259            return value.toString();
260        }
261        
262        if (value instanceof Boolean) {
263            return value.toString();
264        }
265        
266        if ((value instanceof JSONAware)) {
267            return ((JSONAware) value).toJSONString();
268        }
269        
270        if (value instanceof Map) {
271            return JSONObject.toJSONString((Map) value);
272        }
273        
274        if (value instanceof List) {
275            return JSONArray.toJSONString((List) value);
276        }
277        
278        return value.toString();
279    }

281    /**
282     * Escape quotes, \, /, \r, \n, \b, \f, \t and other control characters 
283     * (U+0000 through U+001F).
284     * 
285     * @param s  the string to be escaped ({@code null} permitted).
286     * 
287     * @return A string.
288     */
289    public static String escape(String s) {
290        if (s == null) {
291            return null;
292        }
293        StringBuffer sb = new StringBuffer();
294        escape(s, sb);
295        return sb.toString();
296    }
297
298    /**
299     * @param s - Must not be null.
300     * @param sb
301     */
302    static void escape(String s, StringBuffer sb) {
303        for(int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
304            char ch = s.charAt(i);
305            switch(ch){
306            case '"':
307                sb.append("\\\"");
308                break;
309            case '\\':
310                sb.append("\\\\");
311                break;
312            case '\b':
313                sb.append("\\b");
314                break;
315            case '\f':
316                sb.append("\\f");
317                break;
318            case '\n':
319                sb.append("\\n");
320                break;
321            case '\r':
322                sb.append("\\r");
323                break;
324            case '\t':
325                sb.append("\\t");
326                break;
327            case '/':
328                sb.append("\\/");
329                break;
330            default:
331                //Reference: http://www.unicode.org/versions/Unicode5.1.0/
332                if ((ch >= '\u0000' && ch <= '\u001F') 
333                        || (ch >= '\u007F' && ch <= '\u009F') 
334                        || (ch >= '\u2000' && ch <= '\u20FF')) {
335                    String ss = Integer.toHexString(ch);
336                    sb.append("\\u");
337                    for (int k = 0; k < 4 - ss.length(); k++) {
338                        sb.append('0');
339                    }
340                    sb.append(ss.toUpperCase());
341                }
342                else {
343                    sb.append(ch);
344                }
345            }
346        }//for
347    }
